metadata.scenario: A homeowner calls to report that the landscaping service was not performed as per the agreement. Category: Service Complaint. Flags: quality_complaint.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, my name is Michael Brown. I found your info through the hospital discharge planning department. Hello, Michael! It’s great to hear from you. How can we help with your father's care? Well, my father has diabetes and needs both wound care and medication management. Absolutely, we can assist with that. What specific concerns do you have? I just want to make sure he’s receiving the right care, especially after his discharge. Of course, that’s very important. We can create a tailored care plan for him. How soon can you start? We can typically begin services within 48 hours of setting everything up. That sounds good. What would the costs be for wound care and medication management? Wound care management ranges from $75 to $95, and medication management is between $65 and $80. Alright, so we’re looking at about $140 to $175 for those services? Yes, that’s correct, Michael. Would you like to schedule an assessment? Yes, please! Great! I can have our Care Coordinator, Lisa, reach out to you. That would be helpful. Can she also help with insurance authorization? Definitely! Lisa is well-versed in insurance matters and will guide you through that process. Perfect. When can I expect her call? Lisa will contact you within the next few hours. Does that work for you? Yes, that works. Thank you! You’re welcome, Michael! Is there anything else I can assist you with today? No, that’s all for now. I appreciate your help! It’s my pleasure! Thank you for considering CareFirst Home Health. Talk soon! Have a great day, Michael!
